issues.description: Step 2 page is showing the Step 1 room selection UI instead of the anchor question with 2x2 style image grid. The room type selection phase should have already passed, and step-2 should show 'anchor question 1 of 3' with 4 style images in a 2x2 grid.
issues.root_cause: The page at apps/web/app/design/step-2/page.tsx is either missing, not implemented, or incorrectly renders the same room-selection component as step-1. The step-2 page may be importing/reusing the Step1 component, or the file may not exist causing a fallback/redirect to step-1 content. The console logs show page:mount with page='step-2' so the route exists, but the visual content is wrong.
